## Client

### Added

- A game folder that is not a Steam library install (a copied folder, or a folder chosen in Settings) is started directly instead of through Steam, so Connect works on a PC where Steam does not list the game.

Hosting: [SurvivalServers.com](https://www.survivalservers.com/services/game_servers/dimraeth/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=release_notes&utm_campaign=waygate) runs Waygate for you.
